thread:
maria: Heads up — ORCHID customer VPC cutover scheduled tomorrow 02:00 UTC (2h maintenance window). Who's taking deploy + smoke?

sam: I can lead deploy. Planning to start provisioning at 01:50 UTC and kick traffic cut at 02:05. Will run step checklist from runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/orchid-vpc-cutover

li: I’ll do smoke tests post-cut (02:10–02:25). Will run these scripts: `scripts/smoke_endpoints.sh` and `scripts/kv_cache_check.py`.

jess: Customer SRE (Orchid) confirmed their on-call (andre) will be present during whole window and can failover if needed. They asked for 15m notice before cut.

andre: yep, I’ll be on the Zoom and monitoring customer side. Please ping me 02:00 UTC exactly.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `orchid-vpc-cutover-2026-05-04-02`. CI artifact: `build-9832`.

maria: Rollback plan? Who initiates and how will we signal?

sam: Rollback triggered by: (a) >=3 failed smoke endpoints, (b) error rate >2% for 5m, or (c) customer asks to revert. I’ll revert by flipping route back to `orchid-v1` and tearing down green hosts.

li: Add health-check commands to run during cut: `curl -sS https://orchid-api.internal/health | jq .status` and `redis-cli -h 10.12.5.3 ping`. If either fails, call rollback.

jess: Orchids wants logs retained for 48h and will stream syslogs to their Splunk. I shared the ingestion endpoint.

maria: Ops checklist quick: 1) Confirm certs preloaded on nodes (sam) 2) BGP routes validated (netops) 3) KV cache primed (li) 4) Canary traffic at 10% for 5m then ramp (sam)

sam: Certs are uploaded to /etc/redwood/certs/orchid.pem on all green hosts. I verified fingerprint `3f:8b:...` ✅

li: I can prime KV with `python tools/prime_cache.py --dataset orchid-seeds` during provisioning.

andre: Netops (team) will be on standby for route propagation — they asked for the AS-path we’ll advertise. Sam, can you paste the prefix list?

sam: Prefixes: `10.200.0.0/22` and `10.201.0.0/22`. AS-path will be 64512 64555.

maria: Time checks: Start provisioning 01:50, cut 02:05, canary 02:10–02:15, ramp 02:20. Post-cut verification 02:25–02:40. Final sign-off by 02:45.

jess: Customer will run functional test suite and report in #orchid-support Slack channel. They want a short status update 02:30.

li: I'll post smoke results in this thread and tag @sam/@maria.

sam: Last ask — keep maintenance window quiet: please disable non-essential alerts (pagerduty) for orchard-prod during 02:00–03:00 so we avoid noise. I’ll re-enable afterwards.

maria: Got it. I’ll coordinate disabling noisy alerts and will be primary comms. If anything goes off-book, DM me and @li and we’ll escalate.

andre: See you all on Zoom — I’ll arrive 01:55 UTC.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 30 minutes before: `orchid-vpc-cutover-2026-05-04-02`

maria: Thanks team — marking this thread as the single source for updates during the window. :thumbsup:
